title: pyrrosia borneensis
intro: Pyrrosia borneensis, commonly known as the Borneo leather fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and acting as an antioxidant. The health benefits of Pyrrosia borneensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as pain relief, fever reduction, and skin protection. The bioactive constituents of Pyrrosia borneensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
